settings.heading: One size, on purpose
settings.text: Every Norrvyn print is 50 × 70 cm — big enough to set a room's mood, standard enough that frames are everywhere.

settings.heading: Paper you can pet
settings.text: 200 gsm matte, uncoated and softly textured. Colors stay pastel and calm, never glossy or shouty.

settings.heading: Rolled, never folded
settings.text: Shipped in a sturdy tube within 3–5 days, free everywhere in the EU. Creases are not part of the aesthetic.
